workstream: P5 / AC1027 TABLECONTENT border RGB and named-color CMC

authoritativeDwgSpecification.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authoritativeDwgSpecification.finding: CMC carries an RGB value and optional color-name/book-name TV values selected by flag bits 0x01 and 0x02. TABLE cell border color is a CMC field with DXF scalar group 62. The DWG spec does not define a generic group-431 mapping for this nested TABLECONTENT color.

dxfCompatibilityEvidence.finding: The documented color-book result carries an ACI group 62, true-color group 420, and group 430 using BOOK$ENTRY spelling.
Groups 420-427 are 32-bit true-color values; groups 430-437 are strings used for true-color names.
dxf_CMC emits true color at base+420 and serializes book plus entry as one BOOK$ENTRY string at base+430; it does not emit group 431 as the book-name half.

basis.localSchemaBoundary: The nested TABLECONTENT decoder reuses the established color-field scope after group 62. It admits RGB-only, RGB plus color name, and RGB plus BOOK$ENTRY profiles. Group 431, book-only values, and ambiguous multiple '$' separators are refused or unrepresentable.

profile.fixture: Runtime-authored TABLECONTENT records; no drawing fixture files were added.
coverage: RGB plus color name uses group 430
RGB plus color-book and entry uses group 430 BOOK$ENTRY spelling
All supported profiles preserve CMC method and optional-string flag bits
Physical output is checked independently from fresh typed readback
Unsupported CMC method and inconsistent optional-string flags preserve the destination and caller state; corrected same-adapter retry is checked

exampleWire.group431: not emitted for this CMC profile

implementation.behavior: The writer emits group 420 for RGB and composes color-book and entry strings into the group-430 BOOK$ENTRY representation. The nested TABLECONTENT decoder retains the combined text and projects its two components into the existing CMC carrier. It rejects unsupported group-431 input in this color scope and refuses ambiguous or unsupported name/book states before output publication.
implementation.failureRetry: Invalid CMC method, mismatched name/book flag bits, and invalid border override state are refused without replacing a destination sentinel or mutating the caller model. The original model then succeeds on the same adapter, and fresh ASCII/binary readback matches all border fields and the remapped linetype target.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All test inputs are generated at runtime; no external DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limits: This is a scoped serializer/parser profile, not native TABLE rendering or whole-document closure evidence.
The profile does not establish producer-authored TABLECONTENT samples, code-431 semantics in other object contexts, book-only colors, native CAD application acceptance, or a public support claim.
The test exercises the local reader against locally authored writer output; no independent CAD application was run.
